import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax1.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=gender, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(bmi_counts))
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Stress Level vs Physical Activity
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Sleep Duration'], s=100, alpha=0.6, cmap='coolwarm')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
ax5.bar(range(len(disorder_counts)), disorder_counts.values, 
        color=sns.color_palette("Set1", len(disorder_counts)), alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Heart Rate by BMI Category
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Heart Rate', ax=ax6, order=bmi_present)
ax6.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Daily Steps Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(df['Daily Steps'], bins=15, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Occupation Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(10)
ax8.barh(range(len(occupation_counts)), occupation_counts.values, color='teal', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_counts)))
ax8.set_yticklabels(occupation_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax8.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Top Occupations', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, square=True, 
            annot_kws={'fontsize': 7})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
